games.title: Pac-Man
games.author: Roy Massaad
games.description: The arcade classic rebuilt in Flash: clear the maze, dodge four ghosts and chase a high score.
games.controls: Arrow keys (or WASD) to move. Eat every dot to clear the maze; the big dots let you hunt the ghosts.

games.title: Fruit Madness
games.author: Vladimir Belyaev
games.description: Pilot a saucer full of panda, dodge waves of angry fruit and scoop up muffins before the fuel runs out.
games.controls: Arrow keys or WASD to steer the saucer. Grab muffins for fuel, avoid the flying fruit.

games.title: Pixel Shooter
games.author: Ian Ramzy
games.description: Navigate enemy caverns while battling non-stop waves of enemies in this fast pixel-art shooter.

games.title: Mofle Game
games.author: Sindre Sorhus
games.description: A simple little platform Flash game, written in high school and still playable today.
